What is Curcumin?

Curcumin is the primary bioactive compound found in tumeric

Curcumin, the main active compound found in turmeric, is known for its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, that may help support overall health and reduce the risk of chronic diseases.

Why Take Curcumin with CBD?

Curcumin and CBD provide a powerful response to inflammation

Combining CBD with curcumin may enhance anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, potentially boosting overall wellness and providing complementary benefits for joint health, pain management, and overall immune support.

What Makes NextEvo Curcumin Better?

Our proprietary SmartSorb™ technology ensures maximum absorption

Our team of scientists and doctors developed SmartSorb™ Technology to make CBD and curcumin work with your body so that more can get absorbed. Better absorption means that you can get more of the benefits without taking more than your body needs.

How Much Curcumin Should I Take?

Our recommended daily dosage of curcumin tumeric extract is 500mg. This recommendation is linked to clinically supported data on proper dosage. As will all supplements, we encourage you to consult with a healthcare professional before beginning a supplement regimen.

How Much Circumin Should I Take?

When starting a CBD regimen, we recommend beginning with 10-20mg of CBD per day for the first week to ensure it is well tolerated.

You can then gradually increase your daily dose by increments of 5mg until you find your optimal dose, depending on what feels best for you.

settings.title: What is CBD?
settings.text: CBD is the abbreviation for cannabidiol, a natural substance that is one of the most commonly occurring compounds in the Hemp plant. CBD is directly extracted from plants and is 100% natural and has scientifically-backed research has shown that CBD can be beneficial to physical health and mental wellness.

settings.title: Does CBD make you high?
settings.text:
No - CBD will not make you high. This is because CBD is a completely different compound to that of THC (the intoxicating constituent of the cannabis plant). 

Hemp-derived CBD products are non-intoxicating and have zero psychoactive properties. High-quality CBD products can be used safely in your daily routine to support health and promote wellbeing.

settings.title: Is CBD legal?
settings.text:
Yes, CBD products are legal but they must meet regulatory standards. The World Health Organization describes CBD as “generally well tolerated” and as having “a good safety profile”. 

Therefore it is important to only use high-quality CBD products from trusted retailers.
